entries.name: Unbroken Meridians
entries.description: A trace of your combat attributes — max health, attack, defense, mental fortitude, damage reduction, speed, crit and elemental power — survives the realm reset and grows with you as you climb back. Health, energy and stamina regeneration come with it. 0.01% per rank.

entries.name: Treasured Inheritance
entries.description: At rebirth, name one legendary-or-better possession a treasure and hand it down to your family line or your sect. Its stats rise 10% of their base each time it is handed down and only that line or sect may wear it. Requires major realm 8.

entries.name: Iron Will
entries.description: Knocked out for 5% less time, per rank.

entries.name: Opening Strike
entries.description: +3% damage on your first turn of every battle, per rank.

entries.name: Momentum of Ages
entries.description: Begin every battle with 10% of the Qi Surge meter already filled, per rank.

entries.name: Perfect Edge
entries.description: Raise your critical-hit chance cap to 100% (up from 75%) — with enough crit sources, every strike can crit.

entries.name: Boss Slayer
entries.description: +4% damage against region tyrants and world bosses, per rank.

entries.name: Transcendent Edge
entries.description: Raise your crit-chance cap to 200%. Crit chance above 100% has that chance to become a Mega Crit — dealing double crit damage.

entries.name: Tower Memory
entries.description: Each month's tower climb starts 5 floors higher per rank; the floors skipped are cleared, and their rewards wait to be claimed.

entries.name: Bounty Instinct
entries.description: +1 bounty on the board each day, per rank.

entries.name: Dangerous Bounty
entries.description: One of each day's bounties, per rank, is a dangerous one: a far stronger foe for a far richer reward.

entries.name: Tireless Fist
entries.description: Unlock Auto-Combat: repeat-fight a beaten foe as an action (after 10 wins).

entries.name: Beast Lore
entries.description: +4% damage per rank against any beast your soul has felled in a past life.

entries.name: Guardian Bond
entries.description: Guardian eggs hatch 10% sooner and guardian beasts gain 10% more experience, per rank.

entries.name: Bountiful Hunt
entries.description: +10 daily Bonus Yield charges per rank (30 without). Stacks to 4.

entries.name: Hunter of the Possessed
entries.description: Unlock Possessed beasts in Fight Beasts: face any beast you have beaten in its possessed form — 5-10x harder and carrying extra traits. Winning pays 5-10x the spirit stones and its drops are rolled twice.

entries.name: Abundant Harvest
entries.description: Bonus Yield hunts pay +0.5x more per rank: drops up to 5x, Qi up to 4x, weapon and art mastery up to 4x, comprehension up to 3x. Stacks to 4.

entries.name: Swift Wanderer
entries.description: The roads between towns are shorter for you: travel takes 8% less time per rank.

entries.name: The Road Between

entries.name: Secret Realm Sense

entries.name: Soul Wandering
